why_clarity: Payroll and onboarding are rule-driven, but compliance determinations are tested only when authorities disagree.
why_digital: Contracts, payroll and payments run online across borders.

why_ai: Statutory entitlement calculation and accrual are mechanical rules software applies.
why_clarity: Each country's statutory minimum is explicit and checkable per worker.
why_digital: Regimes and records in, entitlements and accruals out online.

why_ai: Fact-dependent legal classification carries liability and is challenged by authorities years later.
why_clarity: Determinations are only proven wrong when a tax or labour authority disagrees.
why_digital: Questionnaires and rules in, determinations out, entirely remote.

why_ai: Signals about real working arrangements exist digitally for software to check.
why_clarity: Classification facts are defined, but true arrangements are verified only under dispute.
why_digital: Engagement and activity data in, verification findings out.

why_ai: Implementing national payroll rule changes is codified maintenance AI can track and apply.
why_clarity: Payroll calculations are exact and verifiable every pay run.
why_digital: Rules and employee data in, payslips and filings out.

why_ai: Contract generation and verification are largely automated already.
why_clarity: Contracts and registrations follow templates, repeated for every hire.
why_digital: Documents and identity checks completed fully online.

why_ai: Versioning, currency tracking and consistency checks on legal rules automate well.
why_clarity: Rules have sources and dates that can be verified, though interpretation varies.
why_digital: Statutes and guidance in, a knowledge base out.

why_ai: Lawful termination needs local counsel's judgment, and tribunals examine whether process was followed.
why_clarity: Statutory steps are defined, but each ending is judged later by a tribunal.
why_digital: Notices and agreements handled remotely, with local tribunal exposure.

why_ai: Most of the role is retrieval, drafting and tracking that AI performs well.
why_clarity: Queries recur, but whether answers were right shows only under challenge.
why_digital: Statutes, inboxes and wikis handled entirely on screen.

why_ai: Answering workers about their notice, benefits and pay uses information the platform already holds.
why_clarity: Questions about entitlements have definite answers from contracts and local law.
why_digital: Worker questions and answers handled through portals and support remotely.
